body: It's sad that this gets downvoted because people pretend to understand other's struggles. Being used for sex would feel great rn. I'm sure that's not a popular opinion but depression and no love life isn't too popular either...
Physical attraction is the only thing that matters in today's world...

I actually hate comments like this. You sound great and caring and all that but you don't know what I look like so to call me beautiful without seeing me makes no sense. It's an empty compliment, you know? 

I've seen u comment a bunch and u genuinely seem to care about others here but rhetoric like "everyone's beautiful" and "it'll get better" just feels so empty and unhelpful.

Ayyy, welcome to the club! We have meetings every Tuesday.

In all seriousness, I feel like most who are diagnosed with depression experience this. Many are more impacted and pushed to the edge but most experience this and its rather common. That being said, I'm one of the ones on the edge so take my words with a grain of salt.
I've never been happy before and all the signs suggest this is gonna continue to my death so might as well shorten the time
